title: Neutrino Capability-Spec Validation Report
description: The translator-owned validation result for a capability-spec, emitted by scripts/validators/validate_capability_spec.py () on stdout and persisted by build-tools BUILD as capability-spec-validation.json. It is a translator->build-tools CONTRACT (): admission consumes it to ground a *verified* capability-spec, so it is version-pinned here. The report NAMES the validated spec's identity (capabilityHash + specHash) so a consumer can BIND it to a specific spec; because the validator recomputes both hashes and fails closed on a mismatch (spec.hash_mismatch), an `ok:true` report attests the declared identity matches the spec's content. `capabilityHash`/`specHash` are null only when the spec is unreadable / has no well-formed identity. Fail-closed (additionalProperties:false).

capabilityHash.description: identity.capabilityHash of the validated spec (semantic identity), or null.

specHash.description: identity.specHash of the validated spec (whole-artifact digest), or null.

file.description: Optional: the input file basename (present in the --out spec.report.json form).

procedure.description: Optional: the validated spec's procedure name (present in the --out form).

signer.description: Optional BUILD signature envelope (): the signer id whose key the signature verifies against. The translator validator itself emits an UNSIGNED report; build-tools BUILD signs it (Ed25519 over the canonical attestation bytes) so admission can trust it came from a trusted source, not a caller. Absent = unsigned (dev/honest-case).

signature.description: Optional BUILD signature envelope (): base64 Ed25519 signature by `signer` over the canonical attestation bytes (kind, schemaVersion, verdict, capabilityHash, specHash). NOT part of the signed payload.

signatureSuite.description: Optional BUILD signature envelope (): the signature suite (only ed25519).
